properties.description:
docker/smoke.sh phase 2. Mints two designs at the registry shape (<root>/<name>/.reflow2/graph) under one root, starts the IMAGE with REFLOW2_REGISTRY_ROOT, opens a session against each over /g/<graph_id>/, writes a Requirement into the first, reads it back there, and asserts it is ABSENT from the second.

WHAT IT ADDS OVER WHAT EXISTS: ver:sessions-cannot-cross-designs and ver:a-session-cannot-name-another-design prove the mechanism against the CRATE, and two_designs_stay_apart_over_the_transport proves it against the built binary. This proves it against the ARTEFACT a consumer pulls — its own entrypoint, its own env, its own unprivileged user, its own libc. Isolation regressions are silent and severe: a handler reaching the wrong design corrupts it rather than erroring.

⚠️ THE ASSERTION IS WRITE-THEN-ABSENT, NOT "BOTH ANSWER". Two empty designs would satisfy the weaker check forever, and a check that cannot fail is worse than none.
properties.findings:
PASSING 2026-09-13, against the built image `reflow2-mcp:dev`, not against the crate. docker/smoke.sh grew a phase 2: it mints two designs at the registry shape under one root, starts the image with REFLOW2_REGISTRY_ROOT, writes a Requirement into design A over /g/<A>/, reads it back from A, and asserts it is ABSENT from B over /g/<B>/. Output: "smoke: registry serving 8d196405bdfbf31b and ba765b203788ecad" then "smoke: OK — two designs in reflow2-mcp:dev stay apart, and a write into one is absent from the other."

⭐ IT CAUGHT A REAL DEFECT ON ITS FIRST RUN, which is the evidence that it is not a check that cannot fail. The ENTRYPOINT used ${REFLOW2_REGISTRY_ROOT:---graph-path "$REFLOW2_GRAPH_PATH"} to mean "registry root, else graph path" — and `:-` substitutes the VALUE when the variable is SET, so registry mode passed /data as a bare argument and clap exited 2. A container that never starts, which is the exact failure class the ENTRYPOINT's own warning is about and which five releases once shipped. Fixed to an explicit `if`, rebuilt, re-run green.

⚠️ THE ASSERTION IS A WRITE-THEN-ABSENT, deliberately, not "both designs answer". Two empty designs would pass the weaker check forever.
properties.name: Two designs under one registry root stay apart inside the published image
